title: Loyalty points accrual calculation consistency
gherkin:
Feature: Loyalty points accrual calculation consistency
  Scenario: Points accrual calculation matches stored and displayed values
    Given a rental transaction with a base price of 100 USD
    And a loyalty points accrual rate of 1 point per 1 USD spent
    When the rental is completed and points are accrued
    Then the calculated points value should be 100 points
    And the stored points value in the database should be 100 points
    And the displayed points value to the user should be 100 points
    And all three values should match exactly
rationale: Ensures that loyalty points accrual maintains consistency across the calculation phase, storage phase, and user-facing display phase. This is the core requirement of R103d applied to the accrual workflow.
usedContextItems: Loyalty points accrual and redemption must maintain consistent currency representation across calculation, storage, and user-facing display

From: finance_director@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-03-03 11:00
Subject: Pilot concern about international billing presentation

Hi Team,

Finance has a concern related to the pilot rollout for internationally billed equipment.

For a subset of high-value inventory, we may need a billing presentation approach that works more cleanly across more than one currency context. The current specification covers general pricing and billing expectations, but it does not go into much detail about how pilot-specific currency presentation or conversion rules should be handled in customer-facing outputs.

Before any implementation shortcut is taken, please clarify whether currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency are supposed to be handled as strict accounting rules, temporary pilot behavior, or only a presentation-layer convention. We want to avoid a situation where the operational display becomes simpler, but the customer-visible totals no longer align cleanly with the underlying financial records.

Best,
Finance Dept.

Subject: Question about promotional content in reminder communications

Hi Team,

For the beta period, Marketing would like to explore whether reminder-style emails could also carry a small promotional or onboarding message, instead of treating product messaging and operational reminders as completely separate streams.

Before we move in that direction, we need guidance on how this should interact with user notification settings. From a campaign perspective, the reminder channel looks attractive because it already reaches active users at important points in the rental journey. However, we do not want to assume that a message containing both operational and promotional content should automatically follow the same preference rules as a purely operational reminder.

Please advise whether this needs a dedicated notification category, a separate consent decision, or a strict separation between transactional and promotional messaging.

Best,
Marketing Dept.
